# Mallick Assist Service

> Lithuania-based support and concierge service helping migrants, students, and diaspora communities with accommodation, hall rentals, currency exchange, buying and selling, and import/export.

Mallick Assist Service provides one trusted local contact for arrivals, families, and businesses across Lithuania. We connect people with vetted housing, event venues, shipping partners, and trade support — and stay involved from first message through completion.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, how it works, testimonials, and contact.
- [Services](/services): All six support services in one place.
- [Accommodation](/accommodation): Short-term and long-term housing across Lithuania.
- [Hall Rentals](/hall-rentals): Venue booking and event planning support.
- [Import & Export](/import-export): Shipping, customs, and logistics support.
- [Contact](/contact): WhatsApp, phone, email, and service request form.
